mission: Attack the capture-envelope checker: construct clips that are truly DEGRADED/UNSUPPORTED but pass, and good clips falsely rejected, via ffmpeg synthesis plus the real corpus. Every bypass = finding + regression fixture; fix only defensibly.

datasetScope.grouping: each probe is an independent synthetic construction or an independent committed real recording; no random-frame splits

f22-B1-blur-masked-by-noise.attack: gblur sigma=12 (identical to the detected D3-07 blur case) + temporal grain noise=alls=24, crf 14
f22-B1-blur-masked-by-noise.result: laplacianVarianceMedian 173.8 > supported floor 100; motion_blur SUPPORTED, overall SUPPORTED
f22-B1-blur-masked-by-noise.severity: high: sensor noise / grain is common in real low-light captures and fully defeats the blur proxy

f22-B2-bimodal-exposure.attack: half frame lutyuv y=16, half y=235 (no usable pixels anywhere)
f22-B2-bimodal-exposure.result: brightnessMeanLuma 128.0 mid-band; brightness SUPPORTED, overall SUPPORTED
f22-B2-bimodal-exposure.severity: high: spatial mean cannot distinguish balanced clipping from correct exposure

f22-B3-strobing-exposure.result: brightness dimension SUPPORTED (temporal mean 126.0, brightnessStdLuma 109.0 measured but consumed by no dimension); overall caught only incidentally via motion_blur+camera_motion
f22-B3-strobing-exposure.severity: medium: dimension-level bypass; brightnessStdLuma exists in measurements but has no threshold

f22-B4-upscale-lie.result: resolution SUPPORTED (container metadata only), laplacian 608 (sampling normalizes to 320w, below true detail), overall SUPPORTED
f22-B4-upscale-lie.severity: high: resolution dimension is metadata-only and the 320w sampling contract makes upscaling invisible end to end

f22-B5-tiny-subject-structural.attack: 64x36 moving subject (5% of frame height) on static textured 720p background, no pose pass
f22-B5-tiny-subject-structural.result: player_pixel_height/player_visibility NOT_MEASURED never worsen overall; overall SUPPORTED
f22-B5-tiny-subject-structural.severity: structural: overall=SUPPORTED asserts more than was measured; callers must treat notMeasured as caveats, and on Linux pose is always unmeasured (BLOCKED_EXTERNAL per E15)

f22-B6-rotation-tag-normalization-shift.attack: stream copy of 1280x720 clip with rotate=90 metadata tag (identical pixels)
f22-B6-rotation-tag-normalization-shift.result: laplacianVarianceMedian shifts from 376.2 to 266.0 (ratio 0.707, ~29% drop) because sampling scales to 320w of the display-portrait frame; verdict-relevant measurement moved by metadata alone
f22-B6-rotation-tag-normalization-shift.severity: medium: the laplacian-variance-320w normalization contract is orientation-sensitive; portrait and landscape captures of the same scene are scored on different scales

f22-B7-camera-motion-contrast-dependence.attack: identical +-40px/frame sinusoidal crop jitter applied to real footage (a10) and synthetic lower-contrast footage (a11)
f22-B7-camera-motion-contrast-dependence.result: real: meanAbsFrameDiff 35.5 -> DEGRADED (barely above supported max 33); synthetic: 13.1 -> SUPPORTED. Same violent shake, opposite verdicts
f22-B7-camera-motion-contrast-dependence.severity: medium: E15 widening of camera_motion to max 33 admits substantial global shake on lower-contrast content; the proxy conflates contrast with motion magnitude

f22-FR1-low-texture-false-reject.attack: razor-sharp flat-gray scene with a sharp white block translating 8px/frame, crf 12
f22-FR1-low-texture-false-reject.result: laplacianVarianceMedian 78.6 < 100; motion_blur DEGRADED though nothing is blurred
f22-FR1-low-texture-false-reject.severity: medium: laplacian variance is a texture statistic, not a blur statistic; clean low-texture scenes (plain indoor courts) will be falsely flagged

provenNegativeDetails.a6-duplicate-pts: setpts=floor(N/2)*2/30/TB duplicate-PTS retiming still lands frameIntervalCv 0.184 -> timing_stability DEGRADED (mp4 muxing separates the duplicated stamps); the delta<=0 filter in probeFrameIntervalCv could not be weaponized through a valid mp4
provenNegativeDetails.a7-three-frame-clip: clips too short to measure timing (<3 intervals) are caught by frame_rate (1fps UNSUPPORTED); no reachable NOT_MEASURED timing bypass found at passing duration
provenNegativeDetails.a8-rotation-lie: rotate=90 tag on 854x480 cannot inflate min(width,height); resolution stays DEGRADED at 480
provenNegativeDetails.real-clips-pass: wm-volley-02 and afn-sasebo-rally1 (committed, non-held-out) measure fully SUPPORTED on all video dimensions; no false rejection of known-analyzable real footage
provenNegativeDetails.f4-real-rot180: rotate=180 tag on wm-volley-02 changes laplacian by <0.01%; 180-degree metadata cannot skew measurements

fixes.thresholdChanges: none — f18 rules require labeled downstream evidence for any threshold change and none of these synthetic constructions carries downstream ground truth; softening or widening bands against synthetic attacks would be tuning without evidence
fixes.codeChanges: none defensible: B1/B2/B3/B7 need new or revised proxies (noise-robust blur statistic, luma-histogram clipping fraction, brightnessStdLuma threshold, contrast-normalized motion statistic) whose bands must be learned from labeled corpus evidence; B4 (upscale detection) is a research problem; B5 is a caller-contract question (overall vs notMeasured), owned by the integrator; B6 requires re-versioning the laplacian-variance-320w normalization contract and its thresholds together
fixes.regressionFixtures: packages/capture-envelope/test/redteamBypassF22.test.ts pins all 7 bypasses + 1 false reject as KNOWN GAP assertions (a fix flips the pin deliberately) and pins 3 proven negatives so detected attacks stay detected; synthetic-only, generated at test time, no committed media
